text:
Lena: Quick heads-up: April webinar registrations dropped sharply overnight, dashboard shows -40% Wed->Thu. Anyone else tracking this?
Arjun: Saw it — landing page traffic steady but CTA clicks lower. Could be A/B issue or script error. :thinking: 
Carmen: I checked the registration form logs. We're seeing a 500 on POST /api/register for a subset of requests from CDN node eu-west-1.
Ben: That would explain the conversions but not the raw sessions. Can you paste the error trace?
Carmen: ```
ERROR 2026-04-14T03:12:08Z POST /api/register 500
TypeError: Cannot read property 'email' of undefined
  at parseForm (/srv/app/registrations/index.js:68:23)
```
Arjun: Looks like a client payload variant is missing form data. Maybe the short-link redirect stripped the trailing fragment used by the SPA to populate the form.
Lena: We rolled a new short-link redirect on Apr 13 11:30 UTC for the launch posts. Could be related.
Carmen: I pushed a hotfix to the form handler to validate input and return 400 instead of blowing up. Deployed to prod at 04:50 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwood/web/pull/878
MetricsBot: Deploy complete to prod (deploy_id=deploy-20260414-04) 
Ben: Good. Can we backfill lost registrations from server access logs for Apr 13-14? I can run a mapping job to match POST attempts to session cookies.
Arjun: If we can recover even 60% that's enough to keep weekly benchmarks sensible. I'll coordinate the backfill.
Lena: For the KPI email on Monday mark registrations Apr 13-14 as "under review" and include one-sentence note: "Form errors on some requests due to redirect change; fix deployed, backfill in progress." Keep it short for execs.
Carmen: Backfill job started (job_id=bf-20260414-02), progress 10%. ETA ~3h.
Ben: I'll message Sales ops to hold outreach for leads with blank source until we reconcile. Filed ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-398
Lena: Thanks all. Ping here when backfill finishes and we'll decide whether to regenerate the KPI snapshot. :thumbsup:
